open_items.owner: Dr. Tomasz Wieczorek / Dr. Idris Farouk
open_items.detail: default_monitor_budget()'s long-running tier had no upper ceiling -- a very large estimated_duration produced an unbounded timeout, defeating the Monitor budget's purpose. Fixed 2026-07-30 with _LONG_RUNNING_TIMEOUT_CEILING_SECONDS (3600s), which never pulls the timeout below the caller's configured base.
test_short_task_monitor_budget_actually_applied_in_dispatch used a 10ms margin between tiered timeout and execute_fn sleep -- a CI-flakiness risk. Widened to 160ms 2026-07-30.

Non-blocking design observation from Wieczorek's 2026-07-30 review: a short-tier task's final, reframed retry (D8) still runs under that same short tier's tight timeout (D2). A real tuning question for the benchmarking pass, not an invented threshold today.
